## 1. Let Claude trigger them automatically

The `description:` field in each agent file is what Claude reads to decide when to spin one up. If you ask something that matches the description, Claude will invoke it without you naming it.

Examples that auto-trigger:
- *"Add a cancellation fee to the cleaning quotes"* → Bud Researcher + Pricing Guard
- *"Build the gift card feature on the shop page"* → Bud Factory
- *"Does this layout work on mobile?"* → Bu
